::: {.column width="54%"}
- `epinowcast` was the attempt at community developed tools. I have
  written 68% of the commits, and 68% of the lines with my bot
- In many cases the package is too complex for anyone else to use
- We see fragmentation, and a lot of small mistakes in outbreak
  modelling that add up to real biases
- The same structural request has been written down in `EpiNow2` four
  times since 2020. Two closed as done, two still open
- We wrote down a [workflow for building these models][wf2], then could
  not follow it with the tools we had built
:::
::::

[wf2]: https://samabbott.co.uk/a-workflow-for-infectious-disease-modelling/
